selection.policy: Exclude known prior titles, IDs, normalized exact contexts/questions. Hash-rank eligible unseen articles; take first four with at least sixteen unique contexts per answerability class. Hash-rank questions, at most one per exact context per class. No model outputs used; do not replace samples after observing results.

scope: New to known project datasets, selected before inference. Public SQuAD dev subset, not official hidden test. Pretraining exposure unknown.
